description: Defines the MatcherValidationEvent class which performs validation and scoring for a Matcher object within the Goteo application, including methods for calculating scores based on profile completeness, overview, criteria, and configuration.

classes.name: MatcherValidationEvent
classes.description: A class that validates and scores a Matcher object, providing methods to calculate profile, overview, criteria, and configuration scores, and to track errors and fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a Matcher object and resets validation state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets scores, errors, and fields to initial state.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys used for scoring and validation.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the current set of keys used for scoring.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the form fields with errors.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the form fields with errors.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates scores for each key and overall global score.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates profile completeness score based on owner data.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates overview completeness score based on matcher data.

methods.name: getCriteriaScore
methods.description: Calculates criteria score based on associated questionnaire.

methods.name: getConfigurationScore
methods.description: Calculates configuration score based on matcher variables.
